name: University of Kent automated high-density bioreactor facility for recombinant protein production (BBSRC ALERT, ambr250; 2018)
brief: A university protein-production facility installs an automated multi-parallel mini-bioreactor system (100-250 mL vessels, robotic liquid handling for fed-batch growth of bacterial or mammalian cells) in a purpose-designed unit to make recombinant proteins at high cell density, for internal and external users.

cost.original: GBP 372,664 (BBSRC award, 2018-2019); converted at ~1.33 USD/GBP (2018 average)
cost.excludes_note: Award value of the BBSRC equipment grant on UKRI Gateway to Research (cost of the ambr250 system as requested; whether it includes VAT, install or service contract is not stated). Purpose-designed room not stated as included. USD figure is my currency conversion, not published.

notes: price_basis=configured, set from the source wording (equipment grant for "an ambr250 bioreactor system") before base/configured catalog prices were researched. Single-system price check with an exact model match (configuration unstated); independent of the catalog's ambr 250 sources (2024-25 US purchases). Opened the Gateway to Research API 3 Oct 2026: project 'An advanced bioreactor facility for automated, industry-aligned production of high-value proteins' (Univ. Kent), fund amount GBP 372,664, start 2018-05, end 2019-05. Abstract quote: "we propose to purchase an ambr250 bioreactor system" (Sartorius). Single-item case: 1 of 1 (100%) maps to sartorius_ambr250 (the abstract does not say 12- vs 24-way configuration; catalog id is the 12-way HT). Grant reference BB/R013802/1 (from the GtR record).
